images.title: A number and its digit sum share a remainder
images.purpose: Shows 7309 and its digit sum 19 both leave remainder 1 on division by 9, and 4581 and 18 both leave remainder 0.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Two matching rows, each a number linked by an arrow to its digit sum, with one shared remainder tag.
images.exact_structure: Row 1: a rounded box 7309, a grey (#6B7280) arrow labelled digit sum pointing right to a box 19, and to the right one amber (#E69F00) tag remainder 1 joined by thin lines to both boxes. Row 2 directly below, same layout: box 4581, arrow, box 18, and one green (#009E73) tag remainder 0 joined to both boxes. Exactly 4 number boxes, 2 arrows, 2 tags. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A number and its digit sum leave the same remainder on division by 9, so all four statements hold.
images.description: Shows 7309 and its digit sum 19 both leave remainder 1 on division by 9, and 4581 and 18 both leave remainder 0.
images.teaching_notes: The label digit sum appears on both arrows.

image_decisions.why: Linking each number to its digit sum makes the shared remainder, and so all four statements, visible.
